name: cli-journeys
description: The CLI journeys. Its own manifest because it names the published packages a user's project installs, while the rest of test/integration names the workspace packages it exercises directly — two dependency shapes, so two manifests. integration-tests declares this package as a devDependency because its tsconfig typechecks the journeys: that dependency is how Turbo learns to build the published packages before integration-tests#typecheck runs.
